answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The karst holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
